# GitHub configuration

GitHub Actions owns remote build checks and the existing release workflows.
Workflow inputs configure build transport; application behavior remains owned by Dream modules.

| File | Pos | Function |
|---|---|---|
| `workflows/` | CI and release automation | Define backend/frontend build checks and existing deployment jobs. |
